description: Free. Find candidates by function and numeric specs with units, package or stock. Example: query='buck converter', constraints=[{parameter:'vin_max',op:'>=',value:'24 V'}, {parameter:'iout',op:'>=',value:'2 A'}]. Also accepts vds, rds_on, canonical parameter names and text constraints (interface contains I2C). Uses catalogue/JLCPCB parameters and DigiKey parametric filters when configured. Ranks pass/fail/unknown evidence; unknown is unverified. Values retain sources and test conditions. Compact columns/rows by default; verbose returns objects. Does not validate design fit.

value.description: Number with units, e.g. 10 mΩ, or text

in_stock.description: Require positive stock observed within 24h; refresh at most six candidates.

query.description: Function, e.g. buck converter, N-channel MOSFET, 6-axis IMU

name: find_parts
title: Find Parts by Spec
